page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr9i.48xlarge is a memory-optimized instance utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors built on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1536.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to handle high-throughput data transfers. There are no integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.ebmr9i.48xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, massive data processing engines, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy virtualization workloads. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff that optimizes cost efficiency for pure memory and compute-bound enterprise applications.
